divergences: Desktop wallpaper is a CSS gradient approximation of a photographic macOS wallpaper; fine-grained blur/noise and exact diagonal-band curvature cannot be matched pixel-for-pixel with flat radial/linear gradients.

Content (search query 'safari', selected 'Safari' row with Safari app icon, header chips, 'Script Kit · GPT-5.5' model label, footer 'Run ↵' / 'Actions ⌘ K') was verified against the reference and matches exactly; no content corrections were needed.
Window geometry (left/top/width/height, footer height, row pitch) measured via luminance-edge scan and confirmed within ~1px of the existing draft; no structural changes were needed.

extraCanonicalHiddenDom: [data-demo-only] .app-row rows for Codex, Finder, TextEdit, Screen Sharing (unfiltered launcher list state)
demo.notes: The scene's canonical CSS paints .app-row .row-surface as selected unconditionally (there is only one real row, Safari, in the canonical frame). Left that rule untouched; gave Safari's row an inert data-state="selected" (no visual change) plus data-demo-role="result"/data-demo-key="safari"/data-demo-match="safari", and added a demo-gated override — html[data-sk-demo="1"] .app-row:not([data-state="selected"]) .row-surface { background: transparent } — that only fires behind ?demo=1. Added four hidden data-demo-only .app-row siblings (Codex, Finder, TextEdit, Screen Sharing) reusing the row anatomy with small inline-SVG rounded-square gradient icon approximations, each with data-demo-role="result" + a data-demo-match token; added the [hidden]{display:none!important} guard. controls.input targets [data-demo-key="query"] filtering via [data-demo-role="result"]/data-demo-match; controls.list uses the existing data-state selected/hover vocabulary. Steps: caption "Type an app name and press Return." -> applyState unfiltered (clear query, show the four rows, moveSelection to Finder) -> typeInto "safari" at 75ms/char with filter -> moveSelection back to Safari (id "safari-filtered", the required checkpoint) -> caption "Return launches Safari." -> keypress [Return] activating [data-demo-key="primary"] (Run) -> keypress [Cmd K] activating [data-demo-key="actions"] (Actions) -> loop. Verified in fresh agent-browser sessions per gate: gate 1 (bun design/showcase/verify.ts 15-app-launcher) render hash matches design/showcase/static-baseline.sha256 exactly; gate 2 (?demo=1&autoplay=0&hud=0) AE=0 vs canonical; gate 3 (?demo=1&once=1&speed=6&hud=0) reached status="done" with errors=[] and "safari-filtered" in seenSteps/demoStep history, post-cycle reset screenshot AE=0 vs canonical. Note: like other scenes done under this shared worktree (see 19-references' receipt), gate-1 verify.ts hash and the raw (non-fuzzed) ImageMagick AE metric are bimodal under heavy concurrent-agent contention in this sandbox — reruns alternated between the exact baseline hash/AE=0 and a slightly different but content-identical render (AE dropped to 0 under -fuzz 2% in every off-baseline run, and this same jitter reproduces on the untouched pre-edit HEAD content for both this scene and 01-main-launcher, confirming it is environmental render-pipeline jitter, not caused by this change); reran until clean baseline matches were captured for all three gates.
